children: Overview
Sweden industrial components group's Q3 net revenue rose 11% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITA for Q3 increased 18% yr/yr
Q3 order bookings rose 22%, with 12% organic growth
Outlook
Company says market outlook remains stable after first three quarters
Company prioritizes profitable organic growth and disciplined acquisition strategy
Beijer Alma sees good prospects for further expansion through acquisitions
Result Drivers
ACQUISITIONS - Co said acquisitions contributed to net revenue growth, with Beijer Tech revenue growing 28%
COST CONTROL - Co attributed continued earnings improvement to cost control and resilience
